Stock market news | Ashiana Housing ₹1,100 crore senior living land 9 lakh sq ft

Ashiana Housing Ltd, through its joint venture Kairav Developers, bought about 9.57 acres of land near Chennai's East Coast Road for a senior living project.

The development targets roughly 9 lakh square feet of saleable space and could generate around ₹1,100 crore in revenue, highlighting Ashiana's focus on senior living and group housing growth.
